# NIDO Pull Request Template

## Description
<!-- What does this PR do? Why? -->

## Type
<!-- Check one: -->
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] UI/UX improvement
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (all tests)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Human tone guide followed (no AI-tell words, no em-dashes)
- [ ] Privacy principles respected (zero-network, encrypted, local-first)
- [ ] No breaking changes to storage format (or migration included)
